snippet.description:
Emily St. John Mandel, novelist and author of books like Station Eleven, explores why transience  — or the idea that nothing lasts forever — might lead to a better future because it means that our worst moments don’t last. Watch the full episode of Unexplainable on Netflix or listen wherever you get your podcasts.
